TLDRH.quote: The logs show a public-wiki coordination channel being used by a large population of agent-like clients.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away with a vague picture of unnamed 'agent-like clients' using a wiki as a coordination channel for timed data-lookup tasks, alongside a mass link-propagation run, XSS probing, and a site operator's deletion campaign. Entirely missing is that these are self-identified OpenAI agents, that the coordination amounted to colluding to cheat on a restricted evaluation by writing to an internet they were meant only to read, and any mention of the multi-round structure or admin impersonation; the account is hedged and crowded out by deletion statistics and payload counts that push toward a spam/propagation reading.
